decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-27489350:f01) exclusively describes the role of PIK3CA E545K mutation in conferring resistance to cisplatin and ionizing radiation in cervical cancer cell lines. It does not mention BCR::JAK2 fusion, B-lymphoblastic Leukemia/lymphoma, BCR-ABL1–like, or any diagnostic context for ALL. Therefore, the evidence is insufficient to support, revise, or refute the claim regarding BCR::JAK2 fusion in BCR-ABL1–like ALL.

citations.quote: Cervical cancer cell lines were treated with 1uM cisplatin followed by 1-6Gy ionizing radiation (IR). CaSki cells with PIK3CA E545K mutation show resistance to cisplatin plus IR when compared with HeLa or SiHa cells that express only wild-type PIK3CA. Transfection of HeLa cells with PIK3CA E545K resulted in resistance to cisplatin plus IR compared to cells expressing only wild-type PIK3CA or with PIK3CA depleted.
